CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem.
   B. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Journey to Jerusalem has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Journey to Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
